title: Kissed Cheesy Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A post-workout Saudi Arabian dish featuring pecorino and low-glycemic ingredients, perfect for a satisfying meal. The combination of lamb, cheese, and namul-blanch-season creates a jammy and cheesy flavor profile.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb is cooked through.
While the kebabs are cooking, melt the pecorino cheese in a saucepan over low heat.
Once the kebabs are done, brush them with the melted cheese and serve hot.
Garnish with namul and serve immediately.
